blocs.texte: Hi, Ben! | What do you usually do after school?
Well, I finish school at half past three. | I go home and do my homework.
Yes, I do. | I play basketball twice a week, on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
At quarter to five. | I usually play for one hour.
No, I don't. | I don't like water very much.
That's funny! | I love swimming. | I go swimming every Friday.
On Saturdays, I go shopping with my friends. | On Sundays, I usually stay at home and read comics.
I prefer going to the cinema. | I go there with my brother.
